## Italian brainrot scenario clips

`brainrot-1.mp4`, `brainrot-2.mp4`, `brainrot-3.mp4`: 12-second excerpts starting at 00:08, 00:28 and 00:48 of **Party Tunes – Brainrot Rap [Official Video]** (19 May 2025), obtained from https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Italian_Brainrot_music_video.webm on 2026-11-14. That file page labels the work public domain (PD-algorithm). Original source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T_NKi5KHUdI . Transcoded to H.264, centre-cropped to 540×960, audio removed. Party Tunes is credited on each clip; fictional profile is not the creator's account. No endorsement implied.

Used only in `single` / One unusual day and `change` / Three quieter days. Scenario selection is scripted illustration, not content analysis or evidence that a video genre causes mood changes. Other situations retain the Pexels sequence.
